title: Non-technical musician: discover, join, set up and customize a Link Page
description: Walks a non-technical musician through both real acquisition doors (a Link Page's 'Powered by Extra Chill' footer to extrachill.com/power/, and extrachill.link/join), live registration and onboarding, artist-profile creation, every place in the network that should lead to the Link Page editor, and the extrachill.link/edit editor itself: adding a link, changing colors, and turning on the inline newsletter form with a custom description. A fan then subscribes through that form. Server-side grade confirms what persisted.
